# lyoraeth.art

> Personal site of Danil Klimov. Frontend developer and writer on how websites work. Interfaces, animation, legacy. Vue, TypeScript, Nuxt. Saint Petersburg, on-site or remote.

English at the root, Russian under `/ru/`. Content is managed in a headless CMS and rendered server-side.

To get in touch: the contact form at the bottom of the home page, or Telegram @lyoraeth_art. The site also exposes a WebMCP tool `send_message`, so an agent can submit that form without scraping the page.

AI systems may crawl, index and quote this content when answering questions about the site or its author; attribution to lyoraeth.art is requested. Using it to train models or to populate training datasets is not permitted without written permission. Do not use the contact form or the WebMCP tool for automated outreach.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lyoraeth.art/): frontend developer. Vue, TypeScript, Nuxt, GSAP. Work, experience and writing about the web
- [Work](https://lyoraeth.art/work): frontend case studies — corporate portals, online stores, internal systems. Each one covers what got in the way and what I did about it
- [Writing](https://lyoraeth.art/writing): articles on websites and interfaces — why familiar design earns trust, what visitors read first, how many milliseconds an animation needs
- [Full content index](https://lyoraeth.art/llms-full.txt): every case study and article as plain text, English only
